why_agent_cannot: nothing - the domain is dead or looks like a scam
what_human_must_do: Do not touch it: the domain check flagged it. Verify from the project's own X profile.
steps_from_source: Get JUP into a Solana wallet. Check the token address against the one in Jupiter's docs .
Connect the wallet at vote.jup.ag , enter an amount and click Stake. Keep about 0.01 SOL for gas.
Stay staked. Your ASR share depends on how much you stake and for how long.
When claims open, connect the same wallet at jup.ag/rewards and claim. Warning ASR is not sent automatically. Rewards you don't claim in time return to the community treasury.
Follow @jup_dao for new proposals, including any vote on Jupuary.
